title: Record the bring-up results; open B- records for driver faults
goal: The bring-up evidence is in the record and every fault has its own record
acceptance: Results of steps 1–6 recorded with the date
Each driver fault has a B- record with a failing test where the bus can be mocked
The guide is corrected where it differed
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: 0.5 h to record and file; fixes are their own records.
